ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Colombia's administratively known PEP and AML/CFT lists maintained by the UIAF (Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero). The corporate formation agent must conduct real-time domestic and international PEP/sanctions screening for all shareholders, directors, and UBOs, document negative hits, and retain the KYC record for at least 10 years per Decree 830/2021 and UIAF Resolution 164/2021.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Societario (RUES) via the Superintendency of Companies and the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) portal: https://www.rues.org.co
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be composed using Spanish alphabet and standard Spanish morphosyntactic conventions; foreign-targeted commercial names may be registered as secondary names if transliterated phonetically into Spanish letters. Use of characters outside the Spanish alphabet is prohibited except for an integral famous mark with prior registration. Must include 'S.A.S.' or full 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' in final name composition.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank or financial institution words (e.g., 'Banco', 'Financiera', 'Aseguradora') requiring prior Ministry of Finance and Public Credit authorization
Government-designated sovereignty tokens (e.g., 'Presidencia', 'Nacional', 'Gobierno', 'Policía') requiring prior presidential or ministerial approval
Terms implying social welfare, health, or public utilities without regulatory authorization
Terms identical to existing legal entity names or leading to confusion with a registered trademark
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon administrative rejection of name clearance, the applicant may file a 'recurso de reposición' (reconsideration) before the Cámara de Comercio registry officer within 10 business days after notification, followed by 'recurso de apelación' to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (Circular 13 of 2020). A certified copy of the rejection resolution, supporting trademark/name evidence, and a written legal brief must be attached. Pending appeal does not suspend the validity of any parallel reservation applicable to alternative names.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for low-risk e-commerce retail (ISIC 4791) provided a physical registered address is identified for service of process and the virtual office provider is an accredited corporate services firm able to accept notifications on behalf of the SAS. The Cámara de Comercio will note 'de carácter virtual' if applicable. High-risk industries with statutory licenses cannot use purely virtual offices. This entity does not require a statutory license, so virtual office use is acceptable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_Risk_5pct_maximum (estimated unannounced on-site inspection probability below 5% for the first 24 months, based on standard registry monitoring patterns and absence of statutory licensing triggers)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-46; supplementary application of Código de Comercio (Decreto Ley 410 de 1971), Articles 110-120 on merchant registration; Ley 1429 de 2010 on formalization incentives
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce) acting through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) online portal, with the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) issuing the NIT tax identification number
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución registered with RUES; Notary-attested public deed (escritura pública) is required only if real property or in-kind contributions exceeding specified thresholds are made
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum subscribed or paid-up capital is required for an S.A.S. under Ley 1258 de 2008. Capital may be zero or symbolic, may be paid in cash or in kind, and the payment schedule may extend up to two years with deferred payments recorded in the deed. No escrow account or bank deposit is mandated
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 OF THE SOLE INCORPORATOR OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. At Bogotá D.C., the sole incorporator resolves: FIRST: The corporation named [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. is constituted under Ley 1258 de 2008. The subscribed capital is COP [AMOUNT] divided into [NUMBER] ordinary shares of equal nominal value, fully subscribed and payable per the deed's payment schedule. SECOND: The registered office is fixed at [ADDRESS], Bogotá D.C., Colombia; all books and official notices shall be kept at this seat. THIRD: [NAME] is appointed sole Legal Representative and General Manager with authority to open bank accounts, execute supply and e-commerce contracts, and represent the company before authorities. Approved unanimously. GOOD.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / RUES online name-match system (Sistema de Homónimos and Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES e-window (www.rues.org.co) or the Chamber's virtual office, submit the proposed corporate name along with up to five alternatives, and request the name-availability certificate. The registry verifies against existing companies, trademarks, and reserved names. The certificate of non-conflict is valid for 30 calendar days and must be attached to the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and alternative names
Valid passport or national ID of each incorporator
Email address and contact details of the sole shareholder
Power of attorney and passport copies if executed via representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a homonymy or trademark conflict is detected, the application is returned; cure by selecting an unused alternative name from the submitted list and re-submitting the same request electronically without reapplying from scratch.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the incorporation deed and statutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Execution by the incorporator and legal counsel; notary public (Notaría) only where real property is contributed to capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing the statutes: company name, corporate purpose covering e-commerce and internet retailing of outdoor sports and camping gear, registered office, share capital schedule, representation rules, and governance. The deed may be signed via certified electronic signature; if real estate is contributed, execute before a notary as escritura pública and register at the Deed Registry (Oficina de Registro de Instrumentos Públicos).
required_dossiers: Proof of authorized capital composition, if in-kind transfers are made
Notarial deed template if real property is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or registry identifies defective clauses, amend the document by supplementary resolution and re-sign; no re-payment of registration tariff applies when corrections are submitted before the next business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RUES registration and issuance of the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (mercantile registrar) via RUES electronic filing gateway
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into RUES, complete the single business registration form (Registro Único Empresarial y Social), upload the signed incorporation deed and name certificate, and pay the registration tariff (approx. USD 12 for minimum capital). The Chamber simultaneously transmits the pre-RUT to DIAN for NIT assignment. Upon approval, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal evidencing legal capacity.
required_dossiers: Corporate email and tax domicile declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues observations (observaciones), submit amended annexes through the Chamber's virtual office within 10 working days; after correction, the registration is perfected without additional legal fees, though revised page fees may apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: DIAN NIT consolidation, RUT activation and electronic invoicing enablement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Virtual Office (Oficina Virtual DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Validate the provisional NIT transmitted by the Chamber; enter the DIAN Virtual Office, verify the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) data, select the tax responsibilities matching ISIC 4791 (online retail of goods), request the digital signature certificate (certificado de firma electrónica), and enable the electronic invoicing system (factura electrónica de venta) compatible with DIAN resolution requirements.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Legal representative national ID or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT due to misalignment with Chamber records, reconcile the data through the pre-RUT resubmission path at the Chamber and re-validate at DIAN; disparities in economic activity codes are cured by amending the RUT and refreshing the NIT profile.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal zoning certificate and Industria y Comercio (ICA) incidental registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Planeación (or municipal planning authority) and municipal treasury (Tesorería) via the RITCA integrated municipal registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the Certificado de Uso de Suelo for the administrative office or fulfillment/warehouse location, confirming that the site permits e-commerce logistics and office use. Register in the municipal Industria y Comercio (ICA) tax cadastre through RITCA, selecting the ICA rate applicable to online retail activities, and secure the corresponding certificate to operate lawfully at the local level.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or ownership title of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If land-use certification is denied or conditioned, cure by selecting another compatible property (commercial/logistics zoning) and resubmit the application; ICA registration errors are corrected by amending the RITCA declaration within the municipal tax period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Occupational safety, fire-safety and social security enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos (official fire brigade); Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL); EPS/pension fund administrators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For any physical office or fulfillment warehouse, obtain the fire brigade safety concept (concepto técnico de seguridad humana) after inspection of extinguishers, exits and electrical installations. Enroll the legal representative and all workers in the social security system (health EPS, pension, ARL) within the statutory deadline of the enrolment month, and complete the occupational risk assessment with a certified health and safety professional.
required_dossiers: Lease contract and floor plan of the workplace
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Fire-safety deficiencies must be corrected through retrofitting works (signage, extinguishers, emergency lighting) followed by re-inspection; ARL affiliation gaps are cured by retroactive enrolment from the date of hire plus payment of corresponding premiums and potential fines imposed by the Ministry of Labour.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo (MINCIT) - Regulatory Directorate; for incidental municipal permits, the local Planning Secretariat and Treasury (ICA cadastre) are the competent authorities; no sectoral industrial license applies to pure online retail under ISIC 4791
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable for ISIC 4791 internet retailing; an optional Certificado de Uso de Suelo and Certificado de Seguridad Humana are only required where an administrative office or fulfillment warehouse is physically operated

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for territorial matters
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category III under Decree 3573 of 2011; no full environmental impact assessment or environmental license is required for e-commerce and warehousing below the threshold; however, packaging extended producer responsibility (EPR) obligations apply
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Resolution 1407 of 2022 and Resolution 0641 of 2024 on packaging and container EPR plans; wastewater discharges from office/warehouse must meet Decree 050 of 2018 minimum thresholds before municipal sewer discharge; VOC limits under Resolution 909 of 2008 if any maintenance or repair workshop is operated, which is not contemplated for the declared e-commerce model

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos based on inspection of the physical site; structural load inspection by a certified civil engineer for any warehouse; workplace occupational health clearance reviewed by the ARL and aligned with the Ministry of Labour health and safety standards (Resolution 0312 of 2019)

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Colombia's National Tax and Customs Authority; principal portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional filing system: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) at www.muisca.dian.gov.co. Legal basis: Estatuto Tributario (Decreto 624 de 1989, as amended by Ley 2277 de 2022) and Decreto Único Reglamentario 1625 de 2016.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a locally incorporated S.A.S.: (1) upon registration of the company at the Cámara de Comercio, the system automatically assigns a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria, 10 digits plus verification digit) and issues the preliminary RUT (Registro Único Tributario); (2) the legal representative must enter MUISCA with the Cámara credentials within 30 business days to confirm the RUT data, register the tax responsibilities (IVA 'responsable' and income-tax payer), and arrange the company's digital certificate (firma electrónica) with an DIAN-certified certification authority (e.g., GSE, Certicámara, Andes SCD) for e-filing and e-invoicing; (3) any foreign parent or non-resident shareholder needs no separate Colombian tax ID unless it is itself engaged in Colombian-source activities; the S.A.S. acts as its own taxpayer. For a foreign entity without a Colombian branch or establishment that must still obtain a NIT (e.g., VAT on digital sales or import customs clearing through a broker): appoint a resident legal representative and a tax agent (agente de retención), file the RUT application with apostilled or legalized documents translated into Spanish, and obtain a NIT through DIAN/MUISCA; the resulting 'RUT de responsable del IVA' allows the foreign entity to file periodic VAT returns and issue electronic invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the Colombian S.A.S. is a resident, separate legal entity taxed on worldwide income at the entity level; the standard corporate income tax rate is 35% for fiscal years 2023-2024 and 30% from fiscal year 2025 (per Ley 2277 de 2022). No pass-through treatment is available to an S.A.S.; the company also bears Colombian VAT as a 'responsable del IVA' for its local e-commerce retail sales, and for exports it acts as the exporter of record for VAT zero-rating purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombian law contains no US-style 'check-the-box' regime; entity-level taxation is compulsory for an S.A.S. The statutory elections relevant to this business profile are: (i) 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (SIMPLE) — an optional simplified composite tax regime available to eligible businesses with prior-year gross income not exceeding 100,000 UVT (COP 4,979,900,000 at UVT-2025 of COP 49,799); election is exercised in the first two months of the fiscal year (Form 2593) and replaces the ordinary income-tax/ICA model with a single aggregate rate (2.2% to 14.5% depending on the gross-income band) while simplifying VAT handling for retail operations; (ii) VAT refund election — the exporter may elect between refund (devolución de saldos a favor) and offset (compensación) of the export VAT surplus against other national taxes (arts. 850-857 E.T.); (iii) optional accelerated-depreciation and amortization elections under the E.T. for e-commerce logistics assets; (iv) the hybrid-mismatch rules of arts. 49-52 E.T. are mandatory anti-avoidance adjustments without elective relief; and (v) once the S.A.S. exceeds the statutory size thresholds, it must file transfer-pricing documentation and may adjust its results by 'opción de ajuste integral' (inflation adjustment) only when the law expressly permits it — generally unavailable for recent-year corporations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' assembly approval of the annual financial statements (Asamblea Ordinaria de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate assembly of Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (SAS); minutes recorded in the corporate minute book and made available to the Cámara de Comercio when required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three calendar months of the December 31 fiscal year-end, i.e. on or before March 31 of the immediately following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delay or omission prevents timely deposit of financial statements and renewal of commercial registration; may trigger shareholder claims, liability of legal representatives, and Chamber enforcement for missing mandatory corporate acts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual financial statements (Depósito de Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce with jurisdiction over the registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of the calendar year following the December 31 fiscal year-end, together with the annual mercantile registration renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted deposit triggers renewal surcharges and interest; repeated non-compliance leads to cancellation of the mercantile registration and administrative strike-off from the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of mercantile registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce with jurisdiction over the registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year, irrespective of the incorporation anniversary date; based on the previous December 31 balance sheet
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal accrues monthly surcharges and interest; continued non-renewal results in cancellation of the mercantile registration, suspension of commercial activity, and eventual administrative strike-off of the corporation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual final beneficial owner (UBO) information declaration (Información de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (national tax and customs authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual electronic filing within the DIAN calendar for the prior tax year; the exact due date is assigned by the last digit of the NIT and generally falls between April and July of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late, inaccurate, or omitted UBO information triggers the tax information penalty under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Code, up to 15,000 UVT; may block tax clearance certificates but does not by itself trigger strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory audit is mandatory for a SAS when total assets exceed 5,000 statutory minimum monthly wages (SMLMV) (approx. USD 1.7 million in 2025), or gross annual revenues exceed 3,000 SMLMV (approx. USD 1.0 million in 2025), or the company has more than 200 employees. Below these thresholds, audit is voluntary unless required by bylaws, investors, or a supervisory authority.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian accounting principles under Law 1314 of 2009; the entity applies full IFRS, IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para Pymes), or the microenterprise framework according to Grupo 1, Grupo 2, or Grupo 3 classification; annual financial statements close on December 31.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must record every share transfer in the chronological shareholder register showing date, parties, share class, number of shares, and consideration. For annual compliance, all share transfers during the prior calendar year must be reflected in the DIAN final beneficial owner declaration. There is no separate physical confirmation to the registry beyond the annual DIAN filing and the updated shareholder register available for Chamber inspection.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and board resolutions (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
Minute book for shareholders' assemblies (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Business accounting books (Libro Diario and Libro Mayor)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 - USD 3,500 per audit engagement when a statutory or voluntarily imposed audit is required
